quote: No pedestrian shall cross a roadway at any place other than by a route at right angles to the curb or by the shortest route to the opposite curb except in a crosswalk.

obligation.description: outside a crosswalk, use either a route at right angles to the curb or the shortest route to the opposite curb

exceptions.effect: the outside-crosswalk route alternatives are not the applicable branch

timing.description: observe the pedestrian route from entry at the origin curb to the opposite curb
